items.question: Is this a dark banking design?
items.answer: No. The foundation is intentionally light, with white backgrounds, gray sections, and yellow brand accents.

items.question: Can the homepage be extended later?
items.answer: Yes. The layout is structured so more banking sections and pages can be added without reworking the visual system.

items.question: Does the design support multiple languages?
items.answer: Yes. Uzbek, English, and Russian content stays in dedicated translation files.

items.question: How can I contact the bank?
items.answer: You can call, email, or use the contact form on the contact page.

items.question: What are your working hours?
items.answer: Our team is available Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 18:00 and Saturday from 09:00 to 13:00.

items.question: Can I write to you online?
items.answer: Yes. Use the contact form and we will reply during business hours.

items.question: Do you support multiple languages?
items.answer: Yes. The site is available in Uzbek, English, and Russian.
